items.title: g) Identification of Zinc radical (Zn²⁺) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: g) Identification of Zinc radical (Zn²⁺): a main subheading of 16.7 Tests for identification of basic radicals, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 347-348.

blocks.text: Saaf test tube mein 4 g solid sample lein. 10 cm³ distilled water mein ghol lein. Do hisson (parts) mein baant lein.

blocks.caption: Zinc radical ki pehchan
rows: Pehle hisse mein NaOH solution dalein.
Safed precipitate banta hai jo zyada NaOH mein ghul jata hai.
Doosre hisse mein aqueous ammonia dalein.
Safed precipitate banta hai jo zyada ammonia mein ghul jata hai.

blocks.caption: Milte julte results mein farq karna
rows: NaOH se safed ppt: Ca2+, Al3+, Zn2+
Zn(OH)2 zyada NaOH aur zyada NH3 mein hal; Ca2+ NH3 se sirf halki turbidity; Al(OH)3 gelatinous aur NH3 mein insoluble
NaOH se sabz ppt: Cr3+, Fe2+
Cr(OH)3 zyada NaOH mein sabz solution banata hai; Fe(OH)2 hawa mein orange-bhoora hota hai
sabz jo bhoora ho jaye ke muqable foran orange-bhoora
NaOH se halka neela ppt; zyada NH3 se gehra neela solution

blocks.prompt: a) Lake test kya hai? Equation dein.
blocks.explanation: Yeh Al³⁺ ka test hai. Al³⁺ solution mein thora NaOH (ya ammonia) dal kar Al(OH)₃ ka precipitate banayein aur us mein neela litmus solution dalein. Gelatinous Al(OH)₃ dye (rang) ko apni surface par adsorb kar leta hai aur neeli layer ('blue lake') ban jati hai: Al³⁺ + 3OH⁻ → Al(OH)₃, phir Al(OH)₃ + litmus → blue lake.

blocks.prompt: b) Ammonium ion kaise pehchana jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Sample ko NaOH solution ke saath halka garam karein. Khaas boo wali ammonia gas nikalti hai jo geele laal litmus ko neela kar deti hai: NH₄⁺ + OH⁻ → NH₃ + H₂O.

blocks.prompt: c) Ferrous (Fe²⁺) aur ferric (Fe³⁺) radicals mein farq kaise karenge?
blocks.explanation: NaOH dalne par Fe²⁺ sabz precipitate (Fe(OH)₂) deta hai jo kuch der baad orange-bhoora ho jata hai, jabke Fe³⁺ foran orange-bhoora precipitate (Fe(OH)₃) deta hai.

blocks.prompt: d) Cu²⁺ solution mein aq. NH₃ thori (limited) aur zyada (excess) amount mein dalne se kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Thori ammonia se halka neela precipitate (Cu(OH)₂, ya [Cu(H₂O)₄(OH)₂]) banta hai. Zyada ammonia dalne par yeh precipitate ghul jata hai aur [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺ complex ka gehra neela solution ban jata hai.

items: NaOH ke saath: Al³⁺ safed gelatinous; NH₄¹⁺ garam karne par NH₃; Ca²⁺ safed (excess mein nahi ghulta); Cr³⁺ sabz (excess mein ghulta); Cu²⁺ halka neela; Fe²⁺ sabz jo bhoora ho; Fe³⁺ orange-bhoora; Zn²⁺ safed (excess mein ghulta).

Aqueous NH₃ ke saath: Al³⁺ safed; Ca²⁺ halka dhundlapan ya kuch nahi; Cr³⁺ sabz (excess mein nahi ghulta); Cu²⁺ gehra neela solution; Fe²⁺ safed jo laal-bhoora ho; Fe³⁺ orange-bhoora; Zn²⁺ safed jo excess mein ghul jaye.
